title: Into the Mist
description: Raymarch spheres that fade into fog the farther away they are. The canvas runs from -1 to 1. Camera: ro = (0, 0, 3), rd = normalize(vec3(uv, -1)). March up to 64 steps with t += d, hit when d < 0.001, give up when t > 40. The scene is the closest of six spheres: (-1.3, -0.4, 0) radius 0.6, (1.8, 0.3, -3) radius 0.6, (-2.6, 0.6, -6) radius 0.6, (3.2, -0.3, -9) radius 0.6, (-3.8, 0.2, -12) radius 0.6, and (0, 0, -15) radius 0.8. Take the normal from central differences with eps 0.001. Light direction l = normalize(vec3(0.5, 1.0, 0.6)), diffuse = max(dot(n, l), 0.0). The lit colour is (0.85, 0.30, 0.22) * (0.2 + 0.8 * diffuse). The fog colour is (0.75, 0.80, 0.86). On a hit, the final colour is mix(lit, fogColor, 1.0 - exp(-0.15 * t)), where t is the distance marched. A miss is the fog colour itself.
hintText: Fog is a blend between the lit colour and the fog colour. The blend amount is 1 - exp(-density * t): zero at the camera and approaching one far away. Use the fog colour as the background too, so the farthest spheres melt into it.
